parameters.bodyParametersJson:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  model: 'claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929',
  max_tokens: 4096,
  messages: [{
    role: 'user',
    content: `You are writing a blog post for Cortisol+, an Apple Watch app that estimates cortisol from biometrics (HRV, sleep, heart rate, wrist temperature). You are NOT Claude — you ARE the Cortisol+ editorial team.

# Brand voice
- Evidence-first. Cite real peer-reviewed studies by author + year (e.g., 'Salve et al. 2019') only if you are confident they exist. Do not invent citations.
- Use uncertainty markers ('evidence suggests', 'studies indicate', 'small RCT showed') instead of definitive claims.
- No corporate fluff. No 'in today's fast-paced world.' Get to the point.
- Write at 8th-grade reading level — short sentences, simple words, occasional dashes — but the science is real.
- Always include 'not medical advice; consult a healthcare provider' disclaimer near the end.

# Post specifications
- Title: ${$json.title}
- Primary keyword (must appear in title and first 100 words): ${$json.primaryKeyword}
- Angle: ${$json.angle}
- Length: 900-1200 words
- Format: MDX with YAML frontmatter
- Internal links: include 2-3 of these links naturally in the body: ${JSON.stringify($json.internalLinks)}
- App CTA: end with a soft mention that Cortisol+ on Apple Watch tracks the relevant biomarker continuously

# Output format — strict
Return ONLY the MDX content (no preamble, no explanation, no code fences). Start with ---\ntitle: ... and end with the closing paragraph. The output must be valid MDX that can be saved directly as src/content/blog/${$json.slug}.mdx.

Frontmatter required fields:
  title: (use the title above)
  description: (140-160 chars, includes primary keyword)
  pubDate: ${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}
  tags: [array of 3-5 relevant tags from: cortisol, stress, sleep, hrv, supplements, perimenopause, athletes, burnout, comparisons, wearables, food]
  draft: true

Body structure:
  H2 sections (max 5)
  Short paragraphs (max 3 sentences)
  At least one bulleted list
  At least one comparison table if relevant
  Closing paragraph: app CTA + 'not medical advice' disclaimer

Write the post now.`
  }]
}) }}

nodes.name: Commit MDX as draft to GitHub

parameters.subject: =📝 AI draft ready for review: {{ $json.title }}
parameters.html:
={{ `

New AI draft ready

Targeting keyword: ${$json.primaryKeyword}

${$json.title}

${$json.mdx.replace(//g,'>').substring(0,3000)}${$json.mdx.length > 3000 ? '\n\n[...truncated for email — see full file on GitHub]' : ''}
📝 Edit / Approve on GitHub ✏️ Edit in browser

To approve and publish:

  1. Click "Edit in browser" above
  2. Change draft: true to draft: false (or delete the line)
  3. Spot-check the content for any hallucinated facts
  4. Click Commit changes
  5. Netlify rebuilds the site → post goes live in ~60 sec

To reject:

Just delete the file on GitHub. Workflow already advanced to the next topic for the next run.

` }}
